In support of the first Strategic Objective of the Denmark - Bangladesh Strategic Framework, the bilateral development programme will focus on green and socially just economic growth through the food & agriculture sector, and through urban industrial sectors.
Development projects will support green, inclusive and sustainable production sectors and are expected to contribute to the following outcomes:
- Strengthened government and private sector participation in promoting green, resilient, and inclusive development by setting climate and environmental standards that meet upcoming EU requirements for import.
- Strengthened enforcement of labour law, and increased motivation of companies with a view to pursue a sustainable supply chain and decent working conditions.
